newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ARGENTINA TROUNCE COMBINED SERVICES 52-6.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ARGENTINA TROUNCE COMBINED SERVICES 52-6.

text.p: Argentina warmed up for next week's match against England by running in eight tries in a 52-6 victory over the Combined Services on Wednesday.
Argentina, who face England at Twickenham in 10 days, scored four tries in each half and were never under real pressure.
The outclassed Combined Services could reply only with penalties in the 17th and 25th minutes from fly-half Paul Knowles.
However, they did well to hold a team of mostly test players 14-6 until the half-hour mark.
After that the Pumas opened it up, running their penalties and spreading the ball wide at speed.

Their first try came in the 10th minute. A typical running move ended with a long pass to wing Facundo Soler who crossed the line. Four minutes on and lock Jose Simes rounded off a series of drives and a break by number eight Pablo Bouza to score.
Despite being opposed by a brave, tireless pack, the Pumas made use of plentiful loose ball to run in two more first-half tries from Bouza and centre Francisco Garcia.
After the break, wing Diego Albanesi, captain Lisandro Arbizu, flanker Martin and hooker Carlos Promanzio brought up the half-century of points.
Fly-half Gonzalo Quesada converted all but the third and fourth tries.
